browserRegressions: startup, subdirectory assets and actual egui canvas
new document, real keyboard editing, preview and theme
shared filename editor and real keyboard command palette
import and exact active UTF-8/CRLF/BOM download
Save As chooses a different downloaded filename and can cancel safely
reload restores all tabs, exact active body, mode and theme
page lifecycle flush preserves a pending new tab on immediate reload
close active browser tab selects remaining document without deleting other notes
invalid extension, UTF-8 and size leave active content unchanged
real async file read cannot overwrite newer selection or a new tab
unchanged renderer helper export returns real sanitized HTML
quota failure is visible; exact current content stays downloadable and retry recovers
cross-tab conflict preserves persisted bytes and in-memory edits
malformed persisted bytes are recoverable and never silently overwritten
storage read denial starts usable editor with visible non-durable warning
origin writer lease blocks a competing editor and releases safely on close
missing Web Locks fails closed instead of admitting an unsafe writer

navigation.native: filesystem folder tabs and folder menus
navigation.shared: one tab-widget painter; labels and data reflect their actual scope

open.browser: browser file picker; import a copy

save.browser: save origin-local draft and download a copy, not overwrite imported disk file

lastTabClosure.native: may close the last folder and return to folder selection

capabilities.browserWriterOwnership: one origin-exclusive Web Locks lease, acquired before App construction and retained through flush/teardown

visualPolicy.baselineUpdates: explicit separately reviewed native-reference update, never ordinary verification
visualPolicy.comparison: matched actual application content, not OS/window decorations or website framing
exceptions: target-specific navigation labels/icons and command availability only where capability table requires it
